page.overview:
Who is Chief Leyden?

Chief Leyden is a character from Mario & Luigi: Brothership.

Chief Leyden is a green-skinned Concordian man. He has bushy white eyebrows and a white moustache. He wears a blue long-sleeved robe with a red belt tied around his waist and dark blue trousers under the bottom half of his robe.

Leyden is portrayed as an incompetent leader, as his son and assistant describes him as sleeping on the job and being unable to change the bathroom lightbulb on by himself in his diary. Despite this, Leyden does care for his son and assistant.

Leyden is first seen outside his house on Bulbfish Island, surrounded by the islanders who blame him for stealing the Bulbfish eggs. Leyden declares his innocence and flees, running inside his house. Inside, he tasks Mario and Luigi (who had arrived on the island) with finding the real culprit. Mario and Luigi deduce Leyden's assistant to be the perpetrator during their investigation, but Leyden is told by his assistant that Princess Burnadette of Skorcheen Island and Prince Chilliam from Slippenglide Island are the thieves, leading to their arrest.
